author: Microsoft
name: Windows Forms App (Application Builder)
description: A prototype Application Builder app. Requires matching in-development .NET 12 WindowsDesktop APIs and Microsoft.Extensions.WinForms.Hosting.
symbols/Framework/description: The prototype framework. An SDK version alone does not provide the required builder APIs.
symbols/skipRestore/description: Skip automatic package restore. Prototype dependencies must be provisioned separately.
postActions/restore/description: Restore packages. This prototype requires matching framework APIs and the development hosting package; see README.md.
postActions/restore/manualInstructions/d: Provision the documented prototype prerequisites, then run 'dotnet restore'.
